name: Boku wa Keiichi Onna Janshi no Itazura
original_name: 僕は圭一 女雀師の悪戯
source:
The protagonist arrives at the high school only to find no rooms left in the male dormitory, so he is assigned to the female dormitory. Of course the girls there are not happy and he is forced to accept mahjong challenges in order to gain his right at the dormitory.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-february-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
